HEEWON STYLE — a premium KOREAN WEBTOON / MANHWA splash illustration of a relationship, lit with cinematic tenebrism. A 2:1 movie frame composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop (nothing important at the top or bottom edge). MEDIUM CLOSE TWO-SHOT, waist-up, both faces large. DRAW IT EXACTLY IN THE STYLE OF THE ATTACHED CHARACTER SHEET: the same clean confident black ink linework, the same manhwa face design (eye shape, brows, nose, jaw, hairline and hair). It must read as an INKED DRAWING: visible line strokes everywhere — bold tapered contour lines around every figure, drawn fold lines in the silk and armour, hair drawn as inked strands, a little cross-hatching and line shading in the shadows — then flat cel-shading in two or three tones per colour, no airbrushed gradients. Each face must be recognisably the character drawn on the sheet, wearing the same clothes. NOT realistic, NOT an oil painting, NOT photoreal, NOT painterly, NOT a 3D render, no skin pores or photographic texture. ONLY THESE TWO PEOPLE in the frame. THE QUEEN AND HER CLEVEREST NEPHEW. Queen Sunduk sits crowned in Silla gold, amused, eyes forward; Chunchu kneels at her shoulder and murmurs a plan into her ear behind his sleeve, a sly smile. She already knows. Vermilion lamp light on her, magenta on him. CHARACTER SHEET (copy these faces, hair and clothes exactly): LEFT of the sheet = QUEEN SUNDUK; RIGHT of the sheet = KIM CHUNCHU. QUEEN SUNDUK — Look: Pale oval face, dark calm eyes; black hair in a full coiled updo; when crowned, the gold Silla tree-and-antler crown hung with jade gogok. Dress: Crimson court robe with gold phoenix brocade, blue embroidered cape-collar, a red ribbon bow at the chest. Crown: Silla gold crown, copied from the attached Cheonmachong museum photo: a broad sheet-gold band with three tall tree-shaped uprights stepped like the character 出 (three tiers of short arms turned up into heart-shaped tips) and two antler uprights at the sides, hung with hundreds of round gold spangles on wires and many curved pale-green jade gogok, two long chains of gold leaf pendants falling from the temples to the collarbones. Thin bright sheet gold, never a European spiked crown, never a solid cast crown or a tiara. Colour #E8552B. | KIM CHUNCHU — Look: Slim and elegant; shoulder-length loose black hair parted in the middle; amused eyes, small knowing smile. Dress: Magenta-crimson silk po with a charcoal sash, dark layered collar. Silk even on campaign. Now: Thin moustache and goatee stubble. Colour #D8258C. LIGHT AND BACKGROUND (dark manhwa tenebrism, like a dramatic manhwa splash page): a MINIMAL MONOTONE background — one flat dark field in a single hue (the characters' colour deepened almost to black), at most a few soft wisps of smoke in that same hue; no set, no architecture, no landscape, no furniture, no props beyond what the characters hold or sit on; ONE hard directional light from the side or below carves the faces and silk in high contrast, the far side of each figure falling off into black shadow, a thin edge of the same light along the silhouettes; deep inky blacks, crisp highlights, strong cast shadows across the faces. Each person's colour is the colour of the light and the shadow-tint on them — never a glow aura or halo. BLOCKING, BODY LANGUAGE AND FACIAL EXPRESSIONS show the relationship at a glance. Faces and clothes from the sheet; new poses, never the sheet's stance. One of each person, never cloned. No text, no lettering, no speech bubbles, no panel borders, no watermark.
